# erofs-utils — Vendored Sources

This directory should contain the erofs-utils source tree (specifically the `lib/` and `include/` subdirectories needed to build `liberofs`).

## How to vendor

Clone the upstream repository and copy the required files:

```bash
# In WSL2
git clone https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/xiang/erofs-utils.git erofs-utils-upstream
cd erofs-utils-upstream

# Run autogen to produce the configure script
./autogen.sh

# Copy relevant source directories into this vendor location:
#   lib/     — library source files (not mkfs/fsck CLI sources)
#   include/ — public headers
cp -r lib include /mnt/e/.../XIME.Tools/src/main/cpp/third_party/erofs-utils/
cp configure /mnt/e/.../XIME.Tools/src/main/cpp/third_party/erofs-utils/
```

After vendoring, run the WSL2 configure script to generate `android-config/<ABI>/config.h`:

```bash
bash XIME.Tools/scripts/wsl2_configure.sh
```

## Expected directory layout

```
third_party/erofs-utils/
├── configure             # autoconf-generated configure script
├── include/
│   └── erofs/
│       ├── erofs.h
│       ├── compress.h
│       └── ...
├── lib/
│   ├── liberofs.c        # (or multiple .c files)
│   └── ...
└── android-config/       # auto-generated by wsl2_configure.sh
    ├── arm64-v8a/
    │   └── config.h
    ├── armeabi-v7a/
    │   └── config.h
    ├── x86_64/
    │   └── config.h
    └── x86/
        └── config.h
```
